ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels localized to circular ring clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across the ventral field, punctuated by discrete, high-contrast white circular rings (rosettes) distributed across both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central U-shaped depression with a wide, obtuse pixel angle and moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes forming a jagged boundary along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve extending from the medial notch to the distal tips of the fluke.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular white rings (5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across the black pigmentation, indicating distinct scar clusters.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular rosette scarring; the distal tips, particularly the right, exhibit irregular, high-contrast pixel clusters suggesting active or past biofouling.
